messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — scheduling a 6h soak tonight 23:30 UTC to validate KV cache warmup + burst patterns. Target: ~1.2M requests over window. anyone object?
chandra: ok for me, will need to bump DB pool to 200 for that window. adding ticket to eng-runtime board.
liam: heads up — saw intermittent 503s during last k6 run; think it's the sticky session bug. Can we route a small replay first and check tail-latency before ramp?
alex: good call. plan: 15m light replay (10rps), 30m gradual ramp to 300rps, 5h steady, 15m cool down. pre-checks: KV cache warmup script, disk iops check, heap/profile capture on OOMs.
sara: @liam which 503s? got logs?
liam: snippets: "upstream read error: connection reset by peer" from proxy logs. I'll attach grep later. For k6 config use: 
```
k6 run --vus 150 --duration 5h --out influxdb=http://perf-metrics:8086 soak.js
```
also please ensure prometheus sd scrape interval is 15s.
marco: devops-bot triggered: deploy:soak-run at 2026-03-18T23:30Z. CI checks ok. :rocket:
alex: @chandra can you open the DB pool bump PR? also toggle kv_cache.max_prefix=64 in staging template.
chandra: PR opened: #2742. Also added smoke query that validates prefix hit rate > 60% after 20m.
liam: small ask for runtime: if tail latency > 5s for p99 during ramp, auto-abort and snapshot KV cache. How do we wire that? Is runtime alerting able to do runbook-triggered abort?
sara: runtime has "soak-run" policy in console. set p99_latency > 5s -> action: abort + collect-profiles. I can add the rule.
alex: please also capture a HPROF and a heap profile for top-allocs if we hit p95>1s for more than 2m. Use /admin/debug/heapdump endpoint.
marco: will add an automation step to curl the debug endpoint and push to s3 with a run id tag.
liam: re: locust/k6 edgecases — some endpoints require sticky cookies; replay tool currently strips set-cookie headers. need a passthrough flag. creating issue in replayer repo.
alex: ok, plan looks good. final checklist: PR merged, k6 script in ops repo, console policy in place, runbook ready, and on-call paged 30m before start. I'll post a final confirmation 30m before.
sara: noted. I'll add the console policy and ping on-call.
devops-bot: Note: soak-run scheduled; alerting policy created; recipients: eng-runtime-oncall.
alex: thanks all. If anything blocks, reply in thread. :thumbsup:
